_comment: Land search 2026-10-15: Evolving Wilds is a REAL land with no mana ability whose '{T}, Sacrifice: search a
basic, onto the battlefield tapped' is a searched trailing activation (PermAbilityMode::SacLandSearch) -- NOT
the fetchland collapse. Board: Rampaging Baloths (can attack), an untapped Evolving Wilds, six Forests; a
Forest in hand. Land drop (a landfall -> a 4/4 Beast, summoning sick) then crack Wilds (a second landfall)
-- neither Beast can attack this turn, so the only damage is Baloths' 6: the opponent at 6 dies on turn 6,
and the two Beasts (8 power) are on the board for turn 7. Pins that the Wilds crack is offered and that it
is never tapped for mana (template custom, produces nothing): Baloths' T7 swing of 6 + 4 + 4 = 14 needs BOTH
Beasts, so opponent life 20 -- 6 on T6 = 14 left -- is lethal on turn 7 only if the crack happened.
